frames.narration: The client picks a creator. From here on it only uses the shared Logistics interface.
Client calls planDelivery(). This method lives in the base class and is identical for every creator.
planDelivery() needs a transport but does not know which kind. It calls its own factory method, createTransport(), which the subclass overrides.
RoadLogistics' version of the factory method builds a Truck.
The base class uses the new object only through the Transport interface.
The result flows back. The client never saw the word Truck.

states.client: got: Truck delivers 40 crates by road

frames.narration: Now swap the creator. Same client code, same method call.
SeaLogistics' factory method builds a Ship instead. planDelivery() did not change at all.
Adding AirLogistics later means one new creator and one new product. Nothing above is edited.

states.client: got: Ship delivers 40 crates by sea
